meta.title: Bid feedback is restricted to the order's team or a super admin
gaps: the case needs a caller who is not a super admin (or lacks a permission), and every run acts as the client's own super-admin buyer — a refusal it expects may legitimately not happen
the decisive step tests something else than the case's point: The setup recipes do not guarantee that the buyer is not on the order's team or is not a super admin.

words.preconditions: A fresh published RFQ event where the invited QA vendor has submitted a bid; bidding still open.
steps: The buyer sends the bid call, the request the case itself writes.
words.expected: The app refuses the step the case is about with a clear message, and never with a server error.
